name: io.github.flow-steward/elastic-agent-builder
title: Elastic Agent Builder
description: Use Elastic Agent Builder tools to search and analyze your Elasticsearch data through your own…

instance_host.description: Kibana host name of your Elastic Cloud deployment, Serverless project or self-managed Kibana (copy the Kibana endpoint from the Elastic Cloud console and drop https://). For a custom Kibana space the path becomes /s/<space>/api/agent_builder/mcp. (for example: my-deployment.kb.us-central1.gcp.cloud.es.io)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Elasticsearch API key with Agent Builder privileges, created in Kibana (Stack Management > API keys) or via the Agent Builder API-key guide; use the base64 'encoded' value returned at creation. Enter it as: ApiKey <value>
